homeLine:
My family helped form a cult.
I write what it costs to see it.
readerLine: If you’re grieving family who are still alive, you belong here.

praise.text: Lilitu writes about survival, identity, and rebuilding yourself from the inside out. Her work is honest, brave, and speaks directly to women doing the hard work of becoming.
Lily's story touched me deeply. I can't wait to read her memoir.
This Substack is a fascinating look at the impact of being in a cult and the aftermath of escape, run by an amazing author and person.

bookDescription: All of this is on the way to my upcoming memoir. It's about a girl who was picked for sweet, grown for somebody else's harvest, and what happened when she finally acknowledged the bruises.
